title: Thunder Breaker — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1500/1510/1511/1512/1514; WZ API for V/HEXA)

skills.name: Electrified
skills.description: Utilize the power of lightning to become more agile. The power of lightning changes the appearance of Elemental Shift.

skills.name: Lightning Punch
skills.description: Throw a lightning-infused punch at enemies. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself.

skills.name: Flash
skills.description: Charges into enemies to deal damage. Charges forward if there are no enemies. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Lightning Elemental
skills.description: Channels the power of a blue-white lightning elemental. Using the skill briefly summons the elemental.

skills.name: Lightning Elemental Adjusted Buff
skills.description: Increases the same amount of stats as those increased by the consumed Lightning Charge. Stacks decrease when Lightning Charge is obtained while active.

skills.name: Knuckle Mastery
skills.description: Increases Knuckle Mastery and Final Damage.

skills.name: Gains
skills.description: Enhances the body through tireless training.

skills.name: Lightning Boost
skills.description: Learn to better command the power of lightning.

skills.name: Sea Wave
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Linking the skill imbues it with the power of lightning and creates a wave that flows towards the enemy. Sea Wave flows in the direction Thunder Breaker is facing when created, searching for the direction with more enemies to attack within a fixed range.
Attacks enemies it runs into while flowing, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to lock Sea Wave activation.

skills.name: Agile Knuckles
skills.description: Increases Knuckle Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Shark Sweep
skills.description: Tap the power of sharks to sweep up nearby mobs. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself.

skills.name: Tidal Crash
skills.description:
Surge forward like ocean waves to sweep up enemies in range. (Some monsters can resist the sweep effect).
Can be canceled by holding the down key while surging forward. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. The wave activates by canceling the skill that was used first. Some skills can link faster with Tidal Crash than other skills. Tidal Crash doesn't generate Lightning Charge.
With Action Customization enabled, you can cancel the skill by pressing its key again, without use of the arrow keys.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: Sea Wave
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Linking the skill imbues it with the power of lightning and creates a wave that flows towards the enemy. Sea Wave flows in the direction Thunder Breaker is facing when created, searching for the direction with more enemies to attack within a fixed range.
Attacks enemies it runs into while flowing and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Seawall
skills.description: Wrap yourself in a torrent that protects you from all attacks.

skills.name: Ironclad
skills.description: Equip resilient armor that attacks and defends.

skills.name: Link Mastery
skills.description: Grants mastery of linking skills, unleashing a strong power when the linked skill hits.

skills.name: Lightning Lord
skills.description: Grants total command over the power of lightning.

skills.name: Ascension
skills.description: A lightning-powered upwards somersault kick. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself.

skills.name: Thunder
skills.description: Blast through the air. Can be used after jumping or after using Ascension. Can be linked with all skills, excluding itself. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Gale
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Unleashes the power gained from using link skills at once. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Typhoon
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Enhances Gale to maximize energy collection from using linked skills, transforming it into a devastating typhoon. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Arc Charger
skills.description: Gathers electricity from your surroundings to make all of your attacks deal additional hits. Does not apply to Summon Skills, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Knuckle Expert
skills.description: Increases Knuckle Mastery, Attack Power, Final Damage, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Electrify
skills.description: Use electricity to supercharge your body.

skills.name: Thunder God
skills.description: Grants absolute control of thunder and storms. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: Gale - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Gale.

skills.name: Gale - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Gale.

skills.name: Gale - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Gale.

skills.name: Thunderbolt - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Thunderbolt.

skills.name: Thunderbolt - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Thunderbolt.

skills.name: Thunderbolt - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Thunderbolt.

skills.name: Annihilate - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Annihilate.

skills.name: Annihilate - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Annihilate's Monster DEF debuff.

skills.name: Annihilate - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monster with Annihilate.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description: Summon a massive charge of electricity to blast enemies in front of you. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself, without activating Lightning Charge. Can link faster with Tidal Crash. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Thunderbolt
skills.description: Call down a destructive bolt of electricity in front of you. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash.

skills.name: Speed Infusion
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed for you and your party members. Can be stacked with other buffs. Also boosts Sea Wave.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Deep Rising
skills.description: Summons the great sea god, damaging enemies on land. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash.

skills.name: Glory of the Guardians
skills.description: A ceremony for Cygnus Knights to pledge their devotion to the Empress.

skills.name: Primal Bolt
skills.description: The lightning of creation that split the heavens strikes you, granting you primal strength, and enhancing the power of Lightning Charge and Link Mastery skill.

skills.name: Lightning Cascade
skills.description: Call upon the full power of the storm to annihilate your enemies with a chain of lightning. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Lightning Cascade
skills.description: Call upon the full power of the storm to annihilate your enemies with a chain of lightning. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Shark Torpedo
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Summons a deadly shark spirit that flies forward, attacking your foes. Can be linked with all skills except for Thunder and itself. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Lightning God Spear Strike
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
The spear of the Thunder God appears and attacks nearby enemies. Can be linked with all skills except for itself, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Turn on Auto Mode to automatically activate Lightning God Spear Strike whenever it is not on cooldown.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Lightning Spear Multistrike
skills.description: Strike with a cascade of lightning that deals linked attacks. Can activate a linked attack by continuing to use the skill. Can link with all skills except for Thunder during Lightning Spear Multistrike. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air. Lightning is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Sea Wave
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Linking the skill imbues it with the power of lightning and creates a wave that flows towards the enemy. Sea Wave flows in the direction Thunder Breaker is facing when created, searching for the direction with more enemies to attack within a fixed range.
Attacks enemies it runs into while flowing, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Permanently enhances HEXA Annihilate.
Right-click to lock Sea Wave activation.

skills.name: Deep Reinforcement
skills.description: Linking the skill instantly creates a shield through the combined powers of the sea and lightning that weakens enemy attacks.

skills.name: HEXA Annihilate
skills.description:
Summons a massive charge of electricity to blast enemies in front of you. Enemies hit by HEXA Annihilate are marked by the Lightning Brand.
Linkable with all skills without activating Lightning Charge, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.

skills.name: Thunder Bolt
skills.description:
Attacks an enemy branded by the Lightning Brand, dropping lightning on them. Lightning Spear Multistrike's linked attack and Thunder Wall Sea Wave cannot brand enemies.
A massive thunderbolt falls on branded enemies when they are attacked with linked skills (excluding Sea Wave, Lightning Spear Multistrike's linked attack, and Thunder Wall Sea Wave). Lightning Strike and the thunderbolt are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Thunderbolt
skills.description:
Calls down a destructive bolt of electricity in front of you. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash.
Periodically uses Thunder Slash instead, which calls down a thunderclap that sweeps across a wide area.
With Action Customization enabled, Thunder Slash activates when using the skill while holding a directional key.
Permanently enhances Lightning Strike's massive thunderbolt.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Thunderbolt
skills.description:
Calls down a destructive bolt of electricity in front of you. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash.
Periodically uses Thunder Slash instead, which calls down a thunderclap that sweeps across a wide area.
With Action Customization enabled, Thunder Slash activates when using the skill while holding a directional key.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Typhoon
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Maximizes the energy collected from using linked skills, transforming it into a devastating typhoon. Can be linked with all skills, excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash. The casting action can be canceled by linking with Tidal Crash in the air.
Increases Buff Duration.

skills.name: HEXA Deep Rising
skills.description: Summons the great sea god, damaging enemies on land. Can be linked with all skills excluding Thunder and itself. Can link faster with Tidal Crash.

skills.name: HEXA Sea Wave
skills.description:
[Link Mastery Skill]
Linking the skill imbues it with the power of lightning and creates a wave that flows towards the enemy. Sea Wave flows in the direction Thunder Breaker is facing when created, searching for the direction with more enemies to attack within a fixed range.
Attacks enemies it runs into while flowing, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Permanently enhances HEXA Annihilate.
Right-click to lock Sea Wave activation.

skills.name: Thunder Wall Sea Wave
skills.description:
Pummels foes with a fist of lightning that splits the seas. With the power of the storm in your hands, even the heavens shall tremble.
When used, Lightning Elemental's Lightning Charge and Link Mastery are applied with max stacks. All Thunder Wall Sea Wave attacks are treated as linked attacks.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Annihilating Rush
skills.description:
Annihilates enemies with the terrible fury of a crashing wave.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
